name: Lysoria
summary: Lysoria is defined by the elegance of fine leather and the craftsmanship of detail. Offered in two variations, one with a half leather finish and the other fully enveloped, each piece is distinguished by a back adorned with hexagonal patterned stitching. The geometric motif adds a tailored sophistication, transforming leather into architecture. Refined and tactile, Lysoria embodies modern luxury shaped through precision and artistry. 181x221x109(150×200) / 211x221x109(180×200)
